GRU decoder: scaling laws¶

Created: 2026-10-05 | Last updated: 2026-10-06

p_L / MWPM on the evaluation block (1.8M shots per distance). Code: figures/scaling_figs.py. To update after new runs (new rows in the newest GRU_all_runs_*.csv in the repo root): from the repo root run jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace notebooks/scaling_laws.ipynb && jupyter nbconvert --to html notebooks/scaling_laws.ipynb, then reload the HTML. Every figure, table and the text above each figure is rebuilt from the data.

In [1]:
%matplotlib inline
%config InlineBackend.figure_format = "retina"
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

# The module lives in figures/; the notebook may be opened from notebooks/ or the repo root.
REPO = Path.cwd().resolve()
if not (REPO / "figures").exists():
    REPO = REPO.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "figures"))
import scaling_figs as sf

pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 120)

data = sf.load_all()

  • d7 u140 constant 3e-3 (new pipeline, val-p_L ckpt): u140 50M s0 2.21x
  • d5 u140 constant 3e-3 (older pipeline, val-loss ckpt): u140 20M s0 0.94x, u140 20M s1 0.94x, u140 20M s2 0.96x, u140 15M s1 0.99x, u140 15M s0 0.99x, u140 15M s2 0.99x, u140 10M s1 1.11x, u140 10M s0 1.12x, u140 10M s2 1.16x

  • d7 cosine 1e-3 + warmup, 80 ep, 200M, two stacked layers (S1, S2, arm b): 2xu280 200M s0 0.72x, 2xu160 200M s0 0.74x, 2xu140 200M s0 0.78x
  • d9 cosine 3e-3, 80 ep, 100M: u280 100M s0 5.02x, u200 100M s0 5.12x, u140 100M s0 12.15x

Peak LR moves p_L most; 80 vs 120 ep and 100M vs 200M at d7 u280 span 0.003x (within noise)

Runs
  • a: d7 u280 50M: u280 50M s1 1.24x, u280 50M s0 1.25x, u280 50M s0 1.79x, u280 50M s0 4.34x (x)
  • a: d9 u280 100M 160ep: u280 100M s0 2.52x, u280 100M s0 2.54x, u280 100M s0 2.83x, u280 100M s0 4.57x, u280 100M s0 pending (val 7.59x)
  • b: noise sweep: u280 100M s0 1.31x, u280 100M s0 1.06x, u280 100M s0 1.04x
  • c: d5 u140 20M s0: u140 20M s0 0.94x, u140 20M s0 1.05x
  • c: d7 u140 50M s0: u140 50M s0 2.21x, u140 50M s0 2.50x
  • d: schedule/data: u280 100M s0 1.06x, u280 100M s0 1.06x, u280 200M s0 1.06x
